nodes.label: Black Masterbatch Pellets – Tonal Studio Shot
nodes.description: Macro studio photograph of black plastic masterbatch pellets (cylindrical/cubic granules) suspended mid-air above a bed of black pellets. All-black tonal palette, dramatic depth-of-field, high-contrast dark aesthetic.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, tonal, all-black, studio, depth-of-field
nodes.subject: black masterbatch pellets

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets – Macro Pour
nodes.description: Macro studio photograph of glossy spherical white masterbatch beads pouring downward onto a mound of the same beads, set against a near-white background. Captures motion and flow in a clean, minimalist composition.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, high-key, minimalist, motion, white-on-white
nodes.subject: white masterbatch beads in pour motion

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets – 3D Backlit Scatter
nodes.description: Close-up of glossy white/grey spherical masterbatch pellets scattered and floating in space with soft backlit glow emanating from behind, creating a three-dimensional luminous effect against a blurred pellet background.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, backlit, 3D depth, luminous, grey-white tones
nodes.subject: white masterbatch pellets with backlit glow

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets on Black – High Contrast
nodes.description: Studio overhead shot of white cylindrical masterbatch pellets clustered and floating above a sea of black pellets. Stark white-on-black contrast composition that visually demonstrates the duality of black and white masterbatch product lines.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, high contrast, black and white, studio overhead
nodes.subject: white masterbatch pellets against black masterbatch background

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets – Flurry Explosion
nodes.description: Overhead macro shot of irregular white masterbatch granules/pellets scattered and exploding outward in a flurry pattern over a dense bed of smaller white pellets. All-white tonal palette, textured, energetic composition.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, tonal, all-white, explosion/scatter motion, textured
nodes.subject: white masterbatch pellet flurry

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets – Tonal Studio Float
nodes.description: Clean studio macro shot of white cylindrical masterbatch pellets suspended floating above a soft-focus bed of smaller white beads. All-white tonal aesthetic with subtle grey shadows distinguishing individual pellet forms.
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, tonal, all-white, floating suspension, soft studio
nodes.subject: white masterbatch cylindrical pellets floating

nodes.label: About Page Hero – 3D Brand B with Pellets (JPEG)
nodes.description: Hero image for the About page: a glossy 3D-rendered letter 'B' in a gradient of deep navy to sky blue, disintegrating into a cascade of blue and white masterbatch pellets scattering leftward on a white background. Strong brand identity visual merging the company initial with the core product.
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, brand typographic, dynamic pellet scatter, blue-white palette, white background
nodes.subject: 3D letter B dissolving into blue and white masterbatch pellets

nodes.description: WebP version of the About page hero: identical composition to about.jpeg — glossy 3D-rendered letter 'B' gradient navy-to-sky-blue, disintegrating into blue and white masterbatch pellets on white background. Higher resolution/quality web-optimised format.
